scope.behavior: Restricted runtime build output in public Actions logs

before_value.build_stream: docker buildx build stdout and stderr are forwarded to the public Actions step log
before_value.failure_message: Docker/BuildKit stdout and stderr are forwarded without a fixed sanitized replacement
before_value.success_message: Docker/BuildKit stdout and stderr are forwarded

after_value.build_stream: docker buildx build stdout and stderr are captured in an ephemeral runner-local file removed on success and at step exit
after_value.failure_message: Restricted runtime build failed; private diagnostics were not published.
after_value.success_message: No Docker/BuildKit build stream is forwarded to the public Actions step log

decisions.compatibility_impact: Public workflow viewers no longer receive raw Docker/BuildKit progress or diagnostics from the restricted runtime build. On build failure they receive a fixed failure category; success remains indicated by the job result. Other workflow steps and private publication gates retain their prior behavior.
decisions.replacement_behavior: Capture the restricted build command's stdout and stderr in an ephemeral runner-local file, remove the file on success and step exit, and print only the fixed failure message on nonzero exit.
